DATABASE_URL.description: Pooled, and it carries the credentials in the string. Four schemes are documented depending on whether you go direct or through Accelerate, whose form embeds an API key in the URL.

DIRECT_URL.description: Bypasses the pooler, which migrations and the CLI need.

DIRECT_DATABASE_URL.description: The same idea under the name Accelerate expects when the pooled string uses the prisma scheme rather than a Postgres one.
